summary: Both halves inspected. Section124 compares the unipotent-bundle approach with de Rham and diagonal-category approaches, emphasizing the additional K functor and the reversed direction of comparison with ordinary types. Two interleaved replacement lines are typed, with pen say of and a tilde. Cancelled total abbreviation and induced by are recoverable. The two earlier functor fragments and the cancelled expression under first to a chain retain only identifiable words, with x-strike noise removed. A tiny k-like mark and the accent in present remain uncertain.
